'''Confederacy of Independent Systems landing zone Aurek''' was a landing zone used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. A [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] landed here and started deploying [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] and at least one [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droid]], [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] and a [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank]]. [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|A Jedi Knight]] fought the droids it had deployed while [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] got into position to fire at the landing craft.

==Behind the scenes==
Confederacy of Independent Systems landing zone Aurek first appeared in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] in the [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] warzone. Once the player destroys the IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank, the final boss for the landing zone, Admiral Wullf Yularen will fire at the landing craft. This damages the player significantly if they are within the blast radius. Just before the craft is destroyed, the landing ramp closes which can make players stuck inside the craft until the wreckage despawns. Players in the area of the craft when it is destroyed also temporarily get 2x credits and crafting materials, which also vanishes if the player logs off.
